title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n teaches the packages group, and both related-list skills name the two routes for a .custom arrangement's tab title
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLGxAx4KpiXZ5b78imiUHke)_

Fixes #37988
Fixes #38128

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：给客户写翻译包的人和 AI 现在能从技能和文档里学到两件新事：软件包的名称怎么按语言显示，定制包自己改的相关列表标签页标题怎么翻译；运行时行为不变。
- 为什么做：是两次已合并改动欠下的技能补课（软件包名称按语言显示、定制包标签页标题按译文显示），不补的话 AI 会漏写软件包名称的译文，或继续走「照抄原标题」这条已不是唯一的老路。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是技能里某句说法和实际行为对不上，AI 写出的翻译会多报或漏报一条提示；只改文字，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：技能文件改动需要你批准合并。

## What changes

**#37988: the translation bundle's `packages` group (shipped in ab044340).**

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the top-level group list: `packages` holds `name` / `description` keyed by `manifest.id`, the dotted id one key, with an inline example; a locale with no row shows `manifest.name`; `os lint` warns `i18n/missing-package` (`os i18n check` lists the same gap by key) until the package's own bundle carries the row.
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`: a "Package name / description" row in "What you can translate" (Setup's package list and Studio's switcher, where an app-carrying package keeps its app's label), and a paragraph with an example under "Draft with the CLI, gate in CI": `os lint` reports `i18n/missing-package`, `os i18n check` lists the key, and the row clears both.
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`: a `packages` line in the `TranslationData` example with a paragraph on the key grammar, the refused spellings and the fallback; and a paragraph in "Orphan Keys and Option Keys": `packages` keys are held to the id grammar at parse, not resolved against manifests, and their coverage is `os lint`'s `i18n/missing-package` warning, which `os i18n check` lists by key. No row in the "Resolves when it names" table, because `os validate` does not resolve these keys (the out-of-scope question #37988 names).

**#38128: a `.custom` arrangement's own tab title translates (shipped in ee2ffca3).**

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `_relatedLists.{list}` row, and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the `relatedLists` bullet: the remedy is now "drop it, or re-state the entry, shown, with a `label`": the owner's own keeps the owner's translation, and the arrangement's own (relationships.md now says "the arrangement's own") is read at the same key from the `.custom` package's bundle, which `os i18n check` expects. The owner-label route stays.
- `i18n-standard.mdx`'s `_relatedLists` row already says this (PR #38085), so it is unchanged.

**Token ratchet** (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`): no raise, no ruling spent. Each addition is paid by deleting restatement in the same file.

- `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` row 6333 → 6315, pinned at the measurement. Cut: the translation-reference paragraph's six-item list of action keys judged against a declaration (each item is already conditioned in the `_actions` row; now one sentence pointing at it, and the row gains "non-empty" on `submitText`, the one nuance only the list carried), and the three code-comment tails of the first example ("one TranslationData per locale", "assemble the locales into one bundle…", "…and register it on the stack"), which repeat the sentence introducing it.
- `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` row 4181 → 4179, pinned at the measurement. Cut: "(cascade delete)" in the type table (Delete Behaviors states it), "to aggregate" after the roll-up intro, the grid example comment "(a field group names invoice_line, as above)", and "places the lines and" in the inline-entry example's comment.

**Changeset**: `.changeset/37988-skills-i18n-packages-group.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch. No package ships `content/docs`.

## Tests

Text only; no runtime code changes. The shapes taught were read on `main`: `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (the `packages` member: id-grammar key, `name` / `description`, aliases `package`, `label`, `title`, `displayName`), `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` (the `package` bucket, `i18n/missing-package`), `StudioPackageSwitcher.tsx` (`appLabel || packageName(p)`), and PR #38085's commit body plus `i18n-standard.mdx`'s `_relatedLists` row. A `tsx` probe of `defineTranslationBundle` from source refused a `crm` key (id grammar) and answered `package` → `packages` and leaf `label` → `name`.

## Acceptance notes

- Branch `claude/project-thread-o2yspl` is assigned by the harness, not the repo's `claude/issue-N-…` convention.
- Open PR #38196 edits other lines of `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (table separators, the Registration paragraph, the `os i18n check` examples). This diff stays out of those lines, and `git merge-tree` of this head with #38196's head is clean. The i18n ratchet row will need a re-measure on whichever lands second; this branch merges `main` again after #38196 lands.
- Contract review 7235862784 (PASS on 49440c78): S1 fixed in 626d0d95 (the id `i18n/missing-package` is `os lint`'s, built by `foldCoverageIssues` in `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`; `os i18n check` prints the key and `source: "package"`, never the id), in the skill and both docs pages; N1 fixed ("or the arrangement's own"); N2 kept as written, as the record accepts.
- Setup's package list fallback to `manifest.name`: confirmed by the review's reading of `PackagesPage.tsx`.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, expect exit 0 with `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 6315 / 6315 and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 4179 / 4179.

Read first, by risk: `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (the `_relatedLists` row and the replaced action-key sentence), `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the remedy), `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (the `packages` paragraphs).
